findings.title: Data cleaning improved quality score
findings.statement: The overall text data quality score increased from 71.2 out of 100 before cleaning to 97.6 out of 100 after cleaning, with 13 documents removed in total.
findings.recommendation: Proceed with using the cleaned dataset for training the classifier.

findings.title: Confidentiality boilerplate dominates text
findings.statement: A confidentiality notice appears in 38.51 percent of raw documents, dominating the vocabulary.
findings.recommendation: Strip boilerplate signatures from support tickets before training models.

findings.title: Presence of personal data in documents
findings.statement: Before cleaning, 12.16 percent of documents contained personal data, including email addresses, phone numbers, and card details.
findings.recommendation: Ensure PII masking is consistently applied to all raw data ingestions.

findings.title: Cross-label duplicates and label mismatches
findings.statement: There were 2 documents appearing in cross-label duplicate groups, and 4 documents read more like another label.
findings.recommendation: Review cross-label duplicates and flagged label mismatches to correct potential mislabeling.

findings.title: Language distribution in raw data
findings.statement: English documents accounted for 93.92 percent of the raw dataset, with 5 documents in other languages.
findings.recommendation: Filter out non-English documents to maintain linguistic consistency.

findings.title: Encoding damage persists in clean dataset
findings.statement: Encoding damage persists in the clean dataset, specifically in document technical/ticket_tech_036.txt.
findings.recommendation: Inspect and clean remaining documents with encoding damage prior to final model training.

narrative.headline: Support ticket dataset quality improved from 71.2 to 97.6 after cleaning and removing 13 documents.
narrative.executive_summary: The support tickets dataset was successfully cleaned, raising its quality score from 71.2 to 97.6 out of 100. A total of 13 documents were removed during the cleaning process, leaving a refined set of English-dominant records. Critical issues like PII, cross-label duplicates, and confidentiality notices dominating 38.51 percent of raw documents were addressed. However, encoding damage still persists in document technical/ticket_tech_036.txt and requires attention.
next_steps: Address the persistent encoding damage in document technical/ticket_tech_036.txt.
Perform human verification on the 4 documents flagged for label mismatches.
Proceed with model training using the cleaned dataset containing 135 remaining documents.
